summary: @ornikar/stylelint-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is an obfuscated script (obfuscator.io fingerprints: `_0xNNNN` identifiers and per-function string-lookup dictionaries) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip into a temp directory, unpacks it (via native unzip, PowerShell Expand-Archive, or an inline ZIP parser fallback), chmods it executable, and then invokes the downloaded Bun binary via execFileSync against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. math_init.js is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a rotated-string-array decoder (WV8StW shift-rotate over an n7gIxM table plus an hc1jfK9 character-map decoder) whose contents are not statically resolvable without runtime decode. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: an unrelated JavaScript runtime is fetched at install time specifically to execute a bundled obfuscated payload that Node-based tooling does not evaluate. A stylelint configuration package has no functional need for an alternate JS runtime, a 727KB obfuscated Bun-only bundle, or an obfuscated preinstall script; the choice of Bun over the already-present Node runtime is an evasion of Node-oriented static analysis.
